warning.titlePre: Jaguar S-Type R Timing Chain Stretch
paragraphs: If your S-Type R has the supercharged 4.2-litre AJ-V8 - that's the X200 generation - timing chain stretch is a documented pattern on this engine, typically between 80,000-150,000km, signalled by cold-start rattle. The chain tensioners and guide rails wear alongside the chain. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, and guide rails as standard on every S-Type R rebuild.
warning.source: Source: verified via multiple independent sources (AutoDoc, LR Engine Specialists), per VRF-jaguar-s-type.md.
